Video of the spectrogram of a WAV file, in sync with its audio

Source: R/spectrogram.R
spectrogram_video.Rd

R draws the spectrogram once and ffmpeg animates it and adds the audio (H.264 + AAC, playable in any player and on social media). Two styles:

  • "cursor": the whole spectrogram, with a line that moves at the pace of the sound.

  • "scroll": the spectrogram scrolls from right to left under a fixed line in the centre (window_s seconds are visible).

Usage

spectrogram_video(
  wav,
  file,
  title = basename(wav),
  subtitle = "",
  marks = NULL,
  style = c("cursor", "scroll"),
  fps = 25,
  window_s = 3,
  max_freq = 12000,
  db_range = 70,
  width = 1280,
  height = 720
)

Arguments

wav

Path of the WAV file (any sample rate; 8 to 32 bits).

file

Output MP4 file.

title, subtitle

Texts of the heading.

marks

Start and end (s) of the detection, marked with dashed lines.

style

"cursor" or "scroll".

fps

Frames per second.

window_s

Seconds visible in the "scroll" style.

max_freq

Highest frequency shown (Hz).

db_range

Dynamic range (dB) of the colour scale.

width, height

Size in pixels.

Value

Invisibly, the path of the MP4 file.

Examples

wav <- tempfile(fileext = ".wav")
t <- seq(0, 2, length.out = 2 * 48000)
tuneR::writeWave(tuneR::Wave(round(8000 * sin(2 * pi * (2000 + 1000 * t) * t)),
                             samp.rate = 48000, bit = 16), wav)
spectrogram_video(wav, tempfile(fileext = ".mp4"), title = "Chirp")
#> ✔ Video in /tmp/RtmpQ97hCs/file22e5162b8a1e.mp4.
